name: Ashwin Dhanasamy
intro: Ashwin Dhanasamy is co-founder of [Vybd](https://vybd.ai), building agentic operations systems that sit on top of the tools a company already runs. Agents reconcile data and propose actions, a deterministic compute layer sits underneath, and humans approve what ships.
He also runs JustLabs, the parent venture studio. His career has been spent building products from 0 to 1, owning engineering end to end and leading designers and PMs.

items.title: Bayangrom operations system
items.note: cut excess inventory 28% and shipping cost 22%, ~$180k/yr recovered

items.title: Product and engineering consultant
items.note: tennis analytics, education, virtual therapy, marine AI
